title: Woofpack
summary: A brand concept for Woofpack, combining fresh dog meal kits with an interactive user experience, brought to life through illustrated app UI, landing page, recipe brochures, packaging, and marketing materials.

meta.Deliverables: App UI, website landing page, recipe brochures, packaging, marketing materials

blocks.label: Overview
blocks.heading: Meal kits you actually make yourself.
paras: Woofpack is a brand concept centered on providing dog owners with fresh recipes and ingredients to create meals at home. It offers a hands-on, engaging experience with full control over the preparation process.

Drawing on both my illustration and design skills, I drafted an app UI, website landing page, recipe brochures, packaging, and various marketing materials to create a cohesive and unified brand experience.

blocks.label: Colour & illustration
blocks.heading: Earthy, but not earnest.
paras: The visual identity features earthy green tones paired with brush-style doodle illustrations, conveying a natural, healthy aesthetic with a playful, handcrafted feel.
